note: Nothing flies differently. The user guide and the changelog now load the first time you open them rather than every time the app starts, so the script the app reads before it draws is 2.38 MB instead of 3.08 MB (688 KB instead of 951 KB gzipped); both still open offline once the app's offline copy is in place. A rail warning now quotes the rail button's name. The 3D view saves the image of a rocket whose name has no letter A-Z or digit as 'rocket-3d.png' (or .jpg); a name only in Cyrillic or other letters outside A-Z, or only in emoji, saved '_-3d.png', and a cleared name '-3d.png'. On Safari and iPhones, a 3D view that could not be downloaded after an update now says so and offers the reload. A number typed into the property panel that overflows when converted is no longer stored, and a parachute with a spill hole and its own Cd but no canopy diameter now has a size line that matches its vented flight. Under the hood: the build and test tools moved to Vite 8 and Vitest 5 and the other dependencies were updated, so npm audit reports nothing; it had flagged 12 packages (23 advisories), none of them in the page the app runs.
